_meta.purpose: Runnable primitive adapted from OpenSRE's crashloop experiment. Payment container is restarted repeatedly during the run. `up{service="payment"}` dips to 0 during each restart; downstream services see conn_error bursts.

title: [Triggered] payment 5xx / downstream failure
message: Downstream calls to payment failing during restart cycles.
